trigger: v1 detected strong identity-matched conditional prediction; v2 found no significant individual-by-location residual after marginal altitude preference was absorbed.

altitude_identity.model: early P_i(z) shrunk toward equal-individual species P(z)
altitude_identity.pairwise_gain: score source i marginal altitude model on target j late z, minus species marginal log score
altitude_identity.support_rule: one-sided p <=0.05 and at least 6/8 diagonal gains >0

horizontal_identity.model: early P_i(cell) across the 18 frozen cells shrunk toward equal-individual species P(cell)
horizontal_identity.pairwise_gain: score source i horizontal cell model on target j late cell, minus species cell-marginal log score
horizontal_identity.support_rule: one-sided p <=0.05 and at least 6/8 diagonal gains >0

location_specific_vertical_interaction.interpretation: already tested as full individual P(z|cell) versus a marginal-altitude-adjusted cell baseline; no reanalysis or threshold change

synthesis_rule.additive_individual_niche_partition: altitude identity and/or horizontal identity passes while v2 location-specific interaction remains unsupported
synthesis_rule.primarily_horizontal_fidelity: horizontal passes, altitude fails, v2 fails
synthesis_rule.primarily_altitude_specialization: altitude passes, horizontal fails, v2 fails
synthesis_rule.compound_altitude_and_horizontal_special: altitude and horizontal both pass, v2 fails
synthesis_rule.unresolved_identity_mechanism: neither altitude nor horizontal passes and v2 fails

prohibited: claiming independence among v1-v3 sequential follow-ups
causal explanation of why individuals differ
